backbone_detail.load: torch.hub.load('facebookresearch/dinov2', 'dinov2_vitb14', pretrained=False) then load_state_dict(torch.load(pt, weights_only=True)) with strict=True. The .pt is backbone weights only -- no probe, no head, no optimizer state.

feature_extraction.note: Plain forward. The DINOv2 hub forward already returns the pooled global embedding, so do NOT call forward_features and do NOT slice tokens.
feature_extraction.post_feature_transform: none (no L2-norm, no pooling, no reshape)

probe.remap_note: The fit covered all 7 classes, so coef rows are already in canonical class order and no column remap is required.
probe.scaler_note: mean/scale come from the fold-0 TRAIN features. Do not recompute them from demo inputs -- that would rescale with the wrong statistics.

provenance.split: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) by lesion_id, fold 0

caveats.balanced_accuracy: 0.4774 -- this probe uses class_weight=None, the registered headline setting. It is accurate on nv (the majority class) and misses often on the rare ones. Show all 7 probabilities, not only top-1.
caveats.autocast: The bank extracted features under torch.amp.autocast('cuda'). A float32 CPU consumer differs in the last decimals; golden.json ships a tolerance for that.

disclaimer: Trained on dermatoscopic images at 224px from HAM10000. This is NOT a diagnostic device and must not be used for medical decisions. Phone-camera photos are out of distribution: the model still outputs confident-looking probabilities that mean nothing. Display it only with this caveat visible.
